name: quadruped-push-up-plus
instructions:
1. Setup in a quadruped position with the hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
2. Push into the floor and allow your shoulder blades to protract around your rib cage.
3. Reverse the movement and retract your shoulder blades while keeping the elbows locked out.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Setup in a quadruped position with the hands under shoulders and knees under hips. 2. Push into the floor and allow your shoulder blades to protract around your rib cage.
